title: Build 3EN Agent Runner v3.6 side-by-side
description: Create Runner v3.6 from the active v3.5 source without replacing or restarting the active runner. Patch terminal-state persistence so SUCCESS, FAILED_BACKUP, FAILED_SCRIPT and FAILED_TEST are all recorded with ID+SHA+status, preventing automatic re-execution of an identical failed task. Add explicit retry metadata support while preserving manual approval. Syntax-validate and statically verify the new file. No active process switch occurs in this task.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $src='C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $src)){throw 'Expected v3.5 source missing'}; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $b=Join-Path 'C:\3EN-Agent\backups\019b' $stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $b|Out-Null; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination (Join-Path $b '3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1') -Force; Set-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-019b-current.txt' -Value $b -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host ('SOURCE_SHA256='+(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $src -Algorithm SHA256).Hash); Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$b); Write-Host 'BACKUP_019B_READY'

test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $f='C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)){throw 'v3.6 file missing'}; $tokens=$null;$errs=$null; [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($f,[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errs)|Out-Null; if(@($errs).Count -gt 0){$errs|ForEach-Object{Write-Host ('SYNTAX='+$_.Message)}; throw ('v3.6 syntax errors='+@($errs).Count)}; $c=Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -Raw; foreach($m in @('3EN Agent Runner v3.6','lastTerminalStatus','Save-State ([string]$task.id) $hash $overall','retryRequested','terminalStatus=')){if($c -notmatch [regex]::Escape($m)){throw ('Missing v3.6 marker: '+$m)}}; if($c -match

){throw 'Old success-only state persistence still present'}; Write-Host 'SYNTAX_ERROR_COUNT=0'; Write-Host 'LOOP_FIX_STATIC_VALIDATION=PASS'; Write-Host ('V36_SIZE='+(Get-Item -LiteralPath $f).Length); Write-Host 'VALIDATION_019B=PASS'
